name: Rosemary
source:
"World famous scientist with a sociable and bright personality, a hard-worker's attitude, great magic powers, and as attractive as she's conceited about all of the above.

It almost seems like all this end of the world business doesn’t get in her way. Does she really not care? Or does she have it all figured it out?"
